analysis.title: MP Materials (MP): Strong results as NdPr reaches record production and magnet commercialization begins; Buy
key_insights: MP reported 3Q26 revenue of $148mn vs GSe/FactSet consensus of $111mn/$117mn. SEG+ inventory sales of $32mn drove most of the beat.

Adj. EBITDA of $41mn beat GSe/consensus of $25mn/~$28mn. Adj. EPS of $0.04 beat GSe/consensus of ($0.05)/($0.02). Underlying NdPr results were broadly in line, with NdPr sales of 1,020 MT vs GSe 1,009 MT.

NdPr production rose 41% yoy to a record 1,018 MT in 3Q26 (GSe 1,050 MT). Sales volumes rose 94% yoy to 1,020 MT. REO production was 12,887 MT vs GSe 13,000 MT. Realized NdPr price was $99/kg vs GSe $98/kg.

MP expects 4Q26 NdPr production of ~1,000 MT because of a scheduled maintenance outage early in the quarter. It operated above 450 MT/month for portions of 3Q and expects a sustainable ~500 MT/month rate over the next several quarters. 2027 NdPr production is expected to exceed 5,000 MT despite additional planned downtime for chlor-alkali and other expansion projects.

MP began operating its heavy rare earths (Dy/Tb) separation circuits in 3Q. Commercial-scale Dy/Tb production is expected to begin in 4Q26 to supply the magnets made at Independence. Samarium and gadolinium projects remain on track for first production in 1H28.

MP sold a modest portion of its stockpiled SEG+ inventory at attractive economics. It kept several hundred tonnes of feedstock for future production and is starting to reintroduce inventory to support the heavy rare earth ramp.

Magnet qualification with GM was completed in 3Q. Shipments of saleable magnets to GM are expected to begin in 4Q26. Volumes stay modest for several quarters as GM phases the magnets into specific programs and plants, then accelerate in 2H27 as Apple production begins contributing.

Magnetics generated $19mn of revenue and $5mn of adj. EBITDA in 3Q26, with about $28mn of deferred precursor revenue left to recognize over the next several quarters. Management expects the segment's 2027 EBITDA contribution to stay modest because declining precursor revenue offsets the early magnet ramp. Full earnings power becomes more visible in 2028.

The 10X magnet facility remains on schedule for commissioning in late 2028 and is already 100% contracted. Customer RFQs and demand indications now well exceed planned capacity, including interest from robotics and technology customers. Management says it can stay selective in pursuing higher-margin opportunities.

Management sees NdPr, not Dy/Tb availability, as the binding constraint on future magnet growth. It believes advances in magnet formulations and grain boundary diffusion could let it serve demand above 10X capacity with formulations that need no heavy rare earths.
The Materials segment generated $8.1mn of PPA income in 3Q26 vs $17.6mn in 2Q26.

MP ended 3Q26 with $1.3bn of cash and equivalents. Year to date it has burned $8mn of operating cash flow and spent $420mn on capex ($113mn in 3Q26), including the 10X site acquisition. It still guides to $500mn-$600mn of 2026 capex. GS believes liquidity is sufficient to fund the long-term capital plan.

GS cut its 12-month price target to $53 from $57, based on 18x (from 22x on lower comps) updated Q5-Q8 adj. EBITDA. Rating stays Buy, with 57.1% upside from $33.74. The stock is down 38.6% over 12 months in absolute terms.

market_movers.rationale: PT cut from $57 to $53 as the target multiple falls to 18x from 22x on lower comps, applied to Q5-Q8 adj. EBITDA. Buy reiterated on NdPr ramp, GM magnet shipments starting in 4Q26 and a growth phase across Materials and Magnetics.

earnings_insights: MP 3Q26 (reported): revenue $147.7mn vs GSe $111.3mn, up 176% yoy and 36% qoq. GSe/FactSet consensus was $111mn/$117mn.
MP 3Q26 (reported): adj. EBITDA $41.1mn vs GSe $25.1mn (consensus ~$28mn). Non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.04 vs GSe ($0.05) and consensus ($0.02). GAAP diluted EPS was ($0.12) vs GSe ($0.09).
MP 3Q26 (reported): gross profit $62.0mn vs GSe $40.0mn. Gross margin was 42.0% vs GSe 36.0%. Operating loss was $22.1mn vs GSe loss of $18.8mn.
MP 3Q26 (reported): operating cash flow was ($12.7mn) vs GSe $51.7mn. Capex was $112.5mn vs GSe $125.0mn. Free cash flow to equity was ($125.2mn) vs GSe ($73.3mn).
MP 3Q26 (reported): Magnetics revenue $19mn and adj. EBITDA $5mn. SEG+ sales were $32mn. PPA income was $8.1mn vs $17.6mn in 2Q26.

GS estimate changes (est): 2026E adj. EBITDA $130mn (from $120mn), 2027E $346mn (prior $352mn), 2028E $598mn (prior $604mn). The text prints the old 2027E figure as '$3352mn', a typo for the exhibit's $352mn.

GS estimates (est): non-GAAP EPS of $0.00 for 2026E (from ($0.06)), $0.56 for 2027E (from $0.59) and $1.33 for 2028E (from $1.36). Revenue is $538.4mn for 2026E (old $516.2mn), $795.6mn for 2027E and $1,051.9mn for 2028E.
GS 4Q26 EPS estimate is ($0.07), after $0.04 in 3Q26. The 1Q27E and 2Q27E estimates are $0.04 and $0.08.
The report's summary table shows 2026E revenue of $538.4mn, while Exhibit 2 shows $463.3mn current vs $444.0mn prior. The source is internally inconsistent on this figure.

trade_ideas.description: Buy MP Materials equity with a 12-month price target of $53
trade_ideas.rationale: NdPr production is at record levels, GM magnet shipments start in 4Q26, and heavy rare earths and magnetics are entering a commercialization and growth phase.
trade_ideas.risk: Operational execution on the NdPr and magnet ramp, commodity pricing for magnets, a higher mix of DoW offtakes, lower-than-expected vertical integration synergies, and easing China-US trade tensions.

risk_factors: Operational execution may fall short of the planned NdPr and magnet production ramp.
Commodity pricing could pressure magnet prices.
A higher mix of DoW offtakes could lower margins.
Cost synergies from vertical integration could come in below expectations, lowering margins.
Planned downtime for chlor-alkali and other expansion projects in 2027, plus the early 4Q26 maintenance outage, will limit NdPr volumes.
Declining precursor revenue offsets the early magnet ramp, keeping Magnetics EBITDA modest in 2027.
Capex of $500mn-$600mn in 2026 and negative free cash flow in the GS forecasts through 2028E.
geopolitical: Easing China-US trade tensions are listed as a key risk to MP's rare earth pricing and demand position.
Management's DoW (Department of War) offtake mix is flagged as a margin risk.

tension_points.bull_case: NdPr production hit a record 1,018 MT, GM qualification is complete with shipments starting in 4Q26, 10X is 100% contracted with demand exceeding capacity, and management targets 2027 NdPr above 5,000 MT.
tension_points.bear_case: 4Q26 NdPr production guides flat at ~1,000 MT on maintenance, 2027 has extra downtime, magnet volumes stay modest for several quarters, Magnetics EBITDA stays modest in 2027 as precursor revenue declines, and free cash flow is negative through 2028E.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Operational execution that fails to ramp NdPr and magnet production as fast as anticipated, or easing China-US trade tensions, would break the bull case.
